(rule!
 ;; Two gray(5) frames hold binary masks — red(2) cells form A, green
 ;; (3) cells form B. The top-row key colors pick boolean ops: 2 = OR,
 ;; 3 = AND, anything else = XOR. Emit one cyan(8) result panel per
 ;; key, side by side with 1-column gaps.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (frame? o)  ;; hollow gray rectangle outline, 3x3+
       (and (= (obj-color o) 5)
            (>= (obj-h o) 3) (>= (obj-w o) 3)
            (= (obj-size o) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) 4))
            (all? (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))
                                  (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))
                                  (= (second p) (obj-c1 o))
                                  (= (second p) (obj-c2 o))))
                  (obj-cells o))))
     (define frames
       (sort (filter frame? (objects g 0))
             (lambda (a b) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))
     (define (mask-of fr color)
       (grid-from-fn (- (obj-h fr) 2) (- (obj-w fr) 2)
                     (lambda (r c)
                       (if (= (at g (+ (obj-r1 fr) 1 r)
                               (+ (obj-c1 fr) 1 c))
                              color)
                           1 0))))
     (define a (mask-of (first frames) 2))
     (define b (mask-of (second frames) 3))
     (define parts
       (map (lambda (key)
              (grid-from-fn (rows a) (cols a)
                            (lambda (r c)
                              (let ((aa (not (zero? (at a r c))))
                                    (bb (not (zero? (at b r c)))))
                                (if (cond ((= key 2) (or aa bb))
                                          ((= key 3) (and aa bb))
                                          (else (not (equal? aa bb))))
                                    8 0)))))
            (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first g))))
     (let ((gh (apply max (map rows parts)))
           (gw (+ (apply + (map cols parts)) (- (length parts) 1))))
       (let loop ((xs parts) (left 0) (out (empty-grid gh gw 0)))
         (if (empty? xs)
             out
             (loop (rest xs) (+ left (cols (first xs)) 1)
                   (for*/fold ((acc out))
                              ((r (range 0 (rows (first xs))))
                               (c (range 0 (cols (first xs)))))
                     (let ((v (at (first xs) r c)))
                       (if (> v 0)
                           (set-cell acc r (+ left c) v)
                           acc))))))))))
